title: Welcome to my homepage!
text:
This is my example website’s homepage. This website is rendered from markdown (.md) files using Quarto and hosted online using Github Pages. This setup predominately relies on plain language YAML (.yml) configuration files rather than web development knowledge.
Write markdown files in any plain text editor then render the whole website from the terminal with quarto render. I use and recommend Obsidian, a robust and extensible plain text editor.
The Github repository can be accessed here.
